name: Tosoh Corporation
summary: Tosoh Corporation engages in the manufacture and sale of basic chemicals, petrochemicals, specialty products, and fine chemicals. The company provides advance materials, including battery materials, fabricated quartzware, silica glass, thin film depositions, and zeolites for catalysts and molecular sieves; and zirconia injection mold components and compounds, grinding and dispersion media, and fine beads and powders. It also offers chromatographic columns, and media and diagnostic systems; clinical diagnostic systems; Portland cement and blast-furnace slag cement; and caustic soda, vinyl chloride monomer, calcium hypochlorite, and sodium bicarbonate.
